purpose: Create source-only component art for the three currently fail-closed functional states: Menu, Upgrade and Error. The sheet is a source for component extraction and choreography, never a complete runtime face card.

output_layout.cell_target: one isolated native-200-compatible floating face on pure white with wide margins; no cell border, caption or grid line

v9_identity_invariants: Keep the exact V9 floating-face character identity: no head, body, ears, hair, frame, card or background.
Keep both black open oval eye silhouettes, their spacing and baseline, with exactly one oval white primary highlight and one diamond white sparkle in each eye.
Keep the small fixed nose and two cheek dots; do not create a new eye shape, eye count, face proportion or character.
All strokes are clean monochrome black on pure white, round-ended and cute; no gray, color, texture, shadow or antialiasing.
Every new functional mark must remain a small separately extractable component and must not cover an eye, brow, nose or mouth.

state_sequences.one_glance_read: opening or choosing from a compact menu
state_sequences.face_response: attentive neutral open eyes, gently lifted brows and a short centred decision mouth
state_sequences.decoration: a small hollow two-by-two navigation grid above the brows; exactly one tiny filled selection dot moves to a neighboring cell across the three frames

state_sequences.one_glance_read: an update or upgrade is progressing upward
state_sequences.face_response: calm positive open eyes, slightly raised brows and a compact hopeful upward mouth
state_sequences.decoration: one thin hollow upward arrow above the brows plus two tiny separated progress ticks below it; the arrow rises one small legal step and the second tick arrives over the three frames

state_sequences.one_glance_read: a clear but gentle problem or error state
state_sequences.face_response: same open V9 eye silhouettes, brows softly angled toward the centre and a single small worried downward mouth
state_sequences.decoration: a small hollow rounded caution diamond above the brows with one compact centre dot; it performs a restrained two-pixel settle rather than shaking wildly
frame_progression: diamond holds with the centre dot

source_gate_before_export: The output must be internally crop-addressable as the nine declared source cells without captions.
Each functional decoration must be extractable into named monochrome component masks, with a recorded anchor, legal offset range and ink/erase operation.
Every face change must map to an existing V9/V22-compatible brow, eye-highlight, cheek or mouth component; never extract a whole face.
Menu, Upgrade and Error must remain visually distinguishable at native 200x200 without relying on text or a full UI screenshot.
No candidate may become runtime active before source, CRIG, browser/WB55 parity and total-audit gates pass.
